description: Na₃NH₆S₂O₁₀ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmc2₁ space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of two Na₃NH₆S₂O₁₀ sheets oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(1), np.int64(0)) direction. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.60 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.50-2.66 Å. N is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two equivalent S and one O atom. Both N-S bond lengths are 1.77 Å. The N-O bond length is 1.40 Å. There are four inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.01 Å) and one longer (1.72 Å) H-O bond length. S is bonded to one N and three O atoms to form SNO₃ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one SNO₃ tetrahedra and  a cornercorner with one ONa₃HN trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.48 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two H atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na, one N, and one H atom to form distorted ONa₃HN trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent SNO₃ tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na and two H atoms.
